title: Limitation of liability.
bodyText: The insurer may in any such policy limit its liability for the same causes and to the same extent as is provided in section 431:10D-312 for other life insurance contracts.
bodyHtml: §431:10D-313  Limitation of liability.  The insurer may in any such policy limit its liability for the same causes and to the same extent as is provided in section 431:10D-312 for other life insurance contracts. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]
